title: Infected World
description: The Infected World Where The World Gets Slowly Infected
body:
# ☣️ Infected World ☣️

**Infected World** is an immersive, survival-horror Minecraft mod that plunges your world into a terrifying, rapidly spreading apocalypse. A malicious entity has breached the Overworld, corrupting the land, mutating the wildlife, and twisting familiar faces into horrific monsters. Will you find a way to cleanse the world, or will you become just another host?

---

## 🎮 Key Features & Gameplay

### 🧟 Twisted Entities & Mobs
The infection doesn't just kill—it mutates. Watch your back, because familiar faces are no longer friendly.
*   **Infected Steve:** A horrifying, mutated version of the classic hero. He retains his strength and intelligence, but is driven entirely by the hunger to spread the virus. He tracks players down and hits hard.
*   **Infected Wildlife:** Passive animals turn hostile once infected, completely disrupting your early-game food sources.

### 🍂 Corrupted Biomes
The virus is actively consuming the Overworld. Explore brand-new, atmospheric **Infected Biomes** where the grass has turned to ash, the trees bleed toxic fluid, and the very air you breathe feels heavy with decay. Survival here requires careful preparation, as the environment itself can drain your health.

### 🌌 A New Realm: The Infected Dimension
If you are brave enough, build a portal and step into the heart of the plague. The **Infected Dimension** is a completely custom, hostile dimension where the infection originated. It features unique terrain generation, eerie ambient sounds, dangerous fog, and exclusive materials needed to craft endgame gear.

### 👹 Epic Boss Battle: The Infected Demon
Deep within the corrupted world lies the source of all this madness: **The Infected Demon**. This colossal, multi-stage boss possesses devastating custom attacks, massive health, and unholy speed. Defeating him is the only way to truly save your world—but it will take full diamond/netherite gear and careful strategy to win.

---

## 🚀 Why Download Infected World?
If you are tired of standard survival and want a true hardcore, horror-themed challenge, this mod is for you. It completely changes how you approach exploration, resource gathering, and combat, turning Minecraft into a thrilling fight for survival against an unstoppable outbreak.

---

> ### ⚠️ Developer's Note
> *Gear up, build your defenses, and trust no one. In the **Infected World**, survival is no longer guaranteed.*
